name: RadioGroup
summary: One choice from a short, fully visible list of mutually exclusive options — role type, window length, a lead's source. Two to about six options; more is a Select. Not for on/off (Switch), not for several picks (Checkbox), not for navigation between views (Tabs). Ships two parts: RadioGroup (the fieldset: name, description, error, orientation) and Radio (one option).

label.requiredWhen: aria-label is not given. The type union refuses a group with neither.
label.intent: The group's visible name — the question the options answer ('Role type', 'Window'). Announced once when focus enters the group, then each radio's own label; never repeated per option.

aria-label.requiredWhen: label is omitted (a group whose question is already a heading beside it).

children.intent: The options, as <Radio> elements, in the order they are read. Two to ~six.

value.intent: Controlled selected value. Pair with onChange.

defaultValue.intent: Uncontrolled initial value. Omit it for a genuine question the user must answer; preselect only a safe default.

onChange.intent: Fires with the selected Radio's value, not the event.

description.intent: Help text under the group name, linked to the group by aria-describedby.

errorMessage.intent: Shown when isInvalid. Present in the DOM before it becomes visible, so the announcement is immediate (same contract as TextField and Checkbox).

isInvalid.intent: Sets aria-invalid on the group and the invalid style on every radio; the form decides validity (e.g. no option chosen on submit).

isRequired.intent: Sets aria-required on the group plus the visible marker on the group name. Native required is not used (ADR-022).

isDisabled.intent: Disables every radio; the group leaves the tab order. A single option is disabled with Radio's own isDisabled.

isReadOnly.intent: Focusable and announced, not changeable, still submitted.

orientation.intent: Layout only; Up/Down and Left/Right both work in either. Horizontal is for 2–3 short labels (e.g. '14 days / 30 days'); it wraps rather than overflows.

name.intent: Native form field name shared by all radios.

size.intent: Row min-height 24 / 44 px per radio (size.target.min / size.target.touch). The circle is 1em of the label's text. No sm.

Radio.value.intent: Required. The value reported by onChange and submitted.

Radio.children.intent: Required. The option's visible label AND accessible name, in a real <label> wrapping the input. A radio has no bare form: an unlabeled option cannot be chosen knowingly.

Radio.isDisabled.intent: Disables this option only; arrow navigation skips it.

keyboard.action: The whole group is one tab stop. Tab lands on the selected radio, or the first enabled one when nothing is selected; Tab again leaves the group.
Moves focus to the next enabled radio AND selects it; wraps from the last to the first.
Moves focus to the previous enabled radio AND selects it; wraps from the first to the last.
Selects the focused radio if it is not yet selected. Nothing deselects — a group with a selection always has one.
Does nothing on a radio (native). Inside a <form> it submits; the group must not intercept it.

a11y.name: Group: from label (aria-labelledby) or aria-label — the type union requires one. Each Radio: from its children, a real <label> wrapping the native input.
a11y.announcements: Entering the group: group name, then 'radio group', then the focused radio's label and 'selected, n of m'. Arrows re-announce each radio as it is selected. isInvalid → aria-invalid="true" on the group and aria-describedby lists description then error. isRequired → aria-required="true" on the group. isReadOnly → aria-readonly="true".
a11y.targetSize: Each radio's label row is the target: md ≥ 24 px tall (2.5.8 AA minimum), lg ≥ 44 (touch). Horizontal groups keep at least space.inline.md between rows so adjacent targets do not touch.

rules: The group is role="radiogroup" named by its label — the ARIA equivalent of fieldset + legend, which is what the Checkbox spec promised for grouped choices. The question is announced once, on entry; never put it in every option.

One tab stop per group (APG roving tabindex): Tab lands on the selected radio or the first enabled one. Arrow keys move focus AND select — there is no 'move without choosing' in a radio group, by design; if choosing must be deliberate, the options are a listbox or buttons.
Nothing deselects. Omit defaultValue for a question the user must answer, and let the form mark the group invalid on submit; never preselect a consequential default to dodge the empty state.
Selected is never colour-only: the inner dot is drawn AND aria-checked is set. In forced-colors mode the circle keeps a FieldText border and the dot uses the system colour.
Invalid is group-level: aria-invalid and the error live on the group, the danger border shows on every radio, and the error text appears once under the group. Never an error per option.
Every Radio has a visible label in a real <label>; there is no aria-label-only radio. Two to about six options — beyond that, a Select; a single option is a Checkbox or a Switch.
Horizontal is layout, not semantics: both arrow axes work in both orientations, and the row wraps on narrow viewports rather than overflowing.
The error element is in the DOM before it is visible (ADR-022: validationBehavior="aria"); Enter is left to the form.
Focus ring is outline + outline-offset on the circle of the focused radio, never box-shadow alone.

properties.Label: label
properties.Error: errorMessage (boolean show + text; visible only when State = invalid)

examples.title: A question with no default
examples.code:
<RadioGroup label="Role type" value={roleType} onChange={setRoleType} isRequired isInvalid={submitted && !roleType} errorMessage="Choose a role type">
  <Radio value="ic">Individual contributor</Radio>
  <Radio value="lead">Lead</Radio>
  <Radio value="manager">Manager</Radio>
</RadioGroup>

examples.title: Short horizontal choice with a safe default
examples.code:
<RadioGroup label="Window" orientation="horizontal" defaultValue="14" description="How long the experiment runs.">
  <Radio value="14">14 days</Radio>
  <Radio value="30">30 days</Radio>
</RadioGroup>

examples.title: One option unavailable
examples.code:
<RadioGroup label="Lead source" defaultValue="board">
  <Radio value="board">Job board</Radio>
  <Radio value="referral">Referral</Radio>
  <Radio value="import" isDisabled>Import (coming)</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
